title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Customer Service Administrator Our client, a dynamic player in the logistics and transportation sector, is seeking a motivated Customer Service Administrator to join their vibrant team in Stoke on Trent, ST1 area. This is a temporary-permanent position offering an exciting opportunity to enhance your career while providing outstanding service to customers. Pay from 12.71ph Hours: Monday-friday 8:30am-5:00pm Role Overview: As a Customer Service Administrator, the successful candidate will be instrumental in ensuring that customer queries are handled efficiently and effectively. This role requires someone with a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and a keen eye for detail. Key Responsibilities: - Process orders and maintain accurate client, stock, delivery, and back order records. - Produce, check and print product, carton, courier, and dispatch labels. - Monitor shared inboxes, respond to routine telephone, and email enquiries. - Record returns and refusals and escalate complaints or complex concerns. - Maintain spreadsheets, databases, and tracking systems. - Work closely with Customer Service, Warehouse and Operations colleagues. Ideal Candidate Profile: - Previous administration, customer service, order-processing or similar experience. - Good Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel skills. - The ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and escalate concerns appropriately. - Experience using order-tracking, CRM, WMS, or label-printing systems is desirable. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy in work. - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. - A positive attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Why Adecco: Annual leave entitlement Perks at work - discount vouchers and points to spend Support program with 24/7 helpline Eye care vouchers Competitive pension scheme Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you. Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer. title: Customer Service Administrator
company: Chase Taylor Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description: Are you an organised and customer-focused administrator with a passion for delivering outstanding service? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy building strong relationships with customers? We're looking for a Customer Service Administrator to become a key member of a busy customer service team, supporting customers from order through to delivery. If you're a great communicator with excellent attention to detail and enjoy solving problems, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll be doing: - Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently. - Handling customer enquiries via phone and email with professionalism. - Providing stock availability updates and delivery ETAs. - Liaising with Sales, Warehouse and Logistics teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment. - Supporting the external sales team with day-to-day administration. - Maintaining accurate customer records and company systems. - Delivering exceptional customer service at every stage of the customer journey. What we're looking for: - Previous experience in a customer service or administration role. - Excellent communication and telephone skills. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload. - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel. - A proactive, positive attitude and excellent attention to detail. - Experience with order processing or within manufacturing, distribution or building products would be advantageous but isn't essential. What's on offer: - Monday to Friday working hours with an early finish on Fridays. - The opportunity to join a well-established, growing business. - Friendly and supportive team environment. - A varied role where your contribution genuinely makes a difference. If you're passionate about customer service and looking for your next opportunity, apply today!
